[SWS_DM_02053] Reporting reset of
ECU
failed to IdsM
Upstream requirements:
RS_Ids_00810
⌈
If a diagnostic service ECUReset is received, which results in a negative response,
the DM shall report a security event SEV_UDS_ECU_RESET_FAILED to IdsM (see
[26] and table [SWS_DM_02054]) with the context data given in [SWS_DM_02054].
⌋
